report.summary: External SMS and push notification vendors experienced severe response latencies, causing message processing lag inside notification-service and delaying delivery of user transaction alerts.

supporting.note: Shows slow SMS vendor response of 5519ms starting right after incident onset.
Shows slow push provider response of 7278ms.
Shows consumer group lag building up in notification-service.
Past incident documents identical symptoms caused by sms-vendor throttling.

contradicting.note: Delays correlate directly with slow external vendor calls rather than internal errors.

facts.text: Support lead reported transaction alerts arriving 5-10 minutes late since ~14:00.
notification-service logged slow responses from sms-vendor and push-provider up to ~8.8 seconds.
notification-service consumer group notif-alerts experienced message lag up to 382 messages.
Scheduled configuration change chg-9140 occurred on notification-service at 07:38.

assumptions: External vendors sms-vendor and push-provider were independently rate-limiting or degraded.
The 503 error on query_metrics did not conceal any critical internal resource starvation.
evidence_gaps: Direct metric telemetry for notification-service was unavailable due to query_metrics backend failure.
Direct log access for external vendors sms-vendor and push-provider.

timeline.event: Approximate onset of user-reported alert delays
First observed slow sms-vendor response time
First observed slow push-provider response time
First logged consumer group lag warning
Incident INC-09 reported by support lead

recommended_actions.action: Check external vendor status pages and contact SMS/push vendor support regarding rate limits.
recommended_actions.rationale: Logs indicate slow vendor calls are the primary bottleneck causing consumer lag.

recommended_actions.action: Scale up worker concurrency or consumer pool size for notification-service.
recommended_actions.rationale: Helps drain the message backlog on event-bus faster during vendor slowdowns.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and fallback routing for third-party notification vendors.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents downstream queue build-up when individual vendors experience latency spikes.
